## Infrastructure PR Description
Please include a summary of the DevOps pipeline or IaC changes made.

## Type of Infrastructure Change
- [ ] CI/CD Pipeline update (Jenkinsfile)
- [ ] Ansible Role / Playbook modification
- [ ] Nginx configuration update
- [ ] Prometheus / Grafana monitoring enhancement
- [ ] Docker Compose update

## Verification Checklist:
- [ ] Validated syntax locally with `docker compose config` or `ansible-playbook --syntax-check`
- [ ] Executed `./scripts/deploy.sh` cleanly
